newsitem.title: FRANCE: Seita gets favourable US court ruling.
newsitem.headline: Seita gets favourable US court ruling.

text.p: French cigarette manufacturer Seita said on Wednesday the New York State Supreme Court denied most of a motion to dismiss its complaint against Salomon Brothers International Ltd related to financial derivative swap products.
Salomon Brother International (SBIL) is an English unit of Salomon Brothers Inc.
The court allowed Seita to proceed with claims against SBIL for breach of fiduciary duty, fraud, misrepresentation, negligence and breach of contract, Seita said.
These claims relate to Salomon Brothers' advice to Seita to invest in high-risk derivative products, which generated a $30 million loss for Seita.

Seita said it also named Salomon Brothers Inc and Salomon Brother Holding Company Inc, two U.S. affiliates of SBIL, as defendents in the suit. The court dismissed Seita's claims against these two without prejudice, allowing Seita to re-plead those claims later if it wants to, Seita said.
Seita said that although certain of its claims were narrowed, the court decision clears the way for Seita to pursue its litigation against SBIL.
Seita said it is pleased by the decision and views the ruling as the first step toward a favourable outcome in the courts, based on the merits of the case.
